season: Game before the 2026-10-08 update · stage cap 770
lede: The daily dungeons (일일던전): each dungeon's boss and entry, and the decks that clear it furthest, full auto first.
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-10-07, the day before the 10-08 easing. Stages are posted screenshots and videos; ranked by stage, never by a ratio.

you.summary: Run EXP on the solo-Brightseeker deck with the Projectile Speed pet, retry until it clears; sweep each dungeon at your wall.
changes: EXP: Brightseeker, Pomegranate, Lime, Milk (captain), Ion, Dark Choco / Cheesecake, Grapevine, Rockstar, Hound, Herb, Moon Rabbit.
Pets Furball Pup, King Choco Drop, Icy Birdie; perks Armor Repair + Health Insurance.
Below a 10★ Brightseeker or about 4G, expect retries; a Conquest gear preset steadies it.
Other dungeons: stack the boss's weakness element; rune crystal runs on full auto longest.
Push for first-clear rewards, then sweep.

daily_dungeon.lede: Each daily dungeon's furthest full-auto deck, then every posted deck by stage.
daily_dungeon.caveat: Bosses, keys and caps from patch notes and screenshots; key refunds on a loss are unconfirmed.

rules.title: Every dungeon is open every day
rules.body: Each has a fixed boss, element and key; stages rise in recommended power. No weekday rotation.

rules.title: Stage cap 770
rules.body: Raised from 570 to 770 on 9/23; the 10-08 update didn't raise it.

rules.title: Keys and sweeps
rules.body: 3 keys a day, up to 6; any cleared stage can be swept; repeat toggle (연속 도전) reruns.

rules.title: Below recommended power, damage drops
rules.body: The stage power brackets apply: auto decks fail when the damage correction falls to about 35%.
